text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: C391 · Listing 9.2 — vector fitting + passivity enforcement (MATLAB)

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a1a1a6

g.text: Chapter 9 — Photonic circuit modelling · Sec. 9.7 Code listings (book p. 343) · uses open-source fitting functions [7]

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64d2ff

g.text: Step 1 — build the S-matrix from the FDTD data (see C382)

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Loads the directional coupler’s saved FDTD S-parameters (file for R = 10 µm, 180 nm gap).

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Averages pairs simulated twice (S12 with S21, S41 with S32), amplitude and phase separately.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Fills the rest by symmetry: six unique values make up a 4×4 matrix at every frequency.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64d2ff
font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Checks the matrix norm at every frequency; if none exceeds 1, the fitting is skipped.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64d2ff

g.text: Step 3 — the fitting loop (see C381, C382)

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Tries fitting orders N = 20 … 100: a vector fit, then passivity enforcement on that fit.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Measures the rms error of both fits against the FDTD data at each N.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Stops early once the enforced fit is passive and its rms error is below 1e-4.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64d2ff

g.text: Step 4 — plots to judge the fit (see C383, C384)

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Plots rms vs. N, residues, amplitude and phase fits, a passivity test (cf. Figs 9.8–9.11).

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64d2ff

g.text: Step 5 — export for INTERCONNECT (used in C385)

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Writes the passivity-enforced S-parameters (magnitude, phase) to a .sparam file.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a1a1a6

g.text: Passive = the device never puts out more power than goes in (S-matrix norm ≤ 1).

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #30d158

g.text: Takeaway: slightly non-passive FDTD data → smooth, passive rational fit → file for circuit models.
